post-summary: January 6, 2027 · Bamboo is three different floors wearing one name: solid refinishes well, strand-woven fights the sander but sands, and engineered lives or dies by its veneer. How to tell which one the 2000s remodel wave left in your Sammamish home, and when replacement is the honest call.
